text:
jamie: Heads-up — hitting onboarding friction with the Go SDK generator streaming + auth refresh flow. Repro attached below, fairly small sample app but fails consistently after ~20s.

nisha: can you paste the minimal repro and the error you see? also which version of the go sdk?

jamie: using v0.12.1 (from go.mod). repro is just: 
```go
ctx := context.Background()
cli := redwood.NewClient(token)
stream, err := cli.GenerateStream(ctx, opts)
for stream.Next() {
  chunk := stream.Chunk()
  fmt.Println(chunk.Text)
}
if err := stream.Err(); err != nil {
  log.Fatal(err)
}
```
It works, but if I rotate the token (simulate refresh) while the stream is open I get: 
```
2026-02-12T15:02:04Z [err] rpc error: code = Unauthenticated desc = "token expired"
2026-02-12T15:02:04Z [info] stream closed prematurely
```
And the client never recovers or retries mid-stream.

linus: this is interesting — sounds like the SDK is binding auth to the initial request and the stream transport doesn't support auth refresh mid-flight. is the token refresh done via a callback on the sdk or are you swapping the Client?

jamie: swapping the client in our app when refresh happens (we have rotating creds). I tried wiring an auth callback but the generator stream internals don't expose a hook to refresh headers once the transport is established.

olivia: is the context being canceled by the refresh code? sometimes people cancel and re-create context which closes the stream too.

jamie: no cancel on our side — we explicitly keep the ctx alive. this is purely the server rejecting the access token mid-stream and the SDK not handling a 401 + token refresh handshake.

linus: proposal: make streaming iterator accept an AuthProvider interface that can return current auth for each request or allow transparent reauth when server returns 401. ergonomics idea: 
```go
type AuthProvider interface {
  Token(ctx context.Context) (string, error)
}

// GenerateStream opts takes AuthProvider, SDK will call it on reconnects
```
That way sample app can keep a single client with rotating tokens behind provider.

nisha: i like that. also add a tiny sample under /sdk/go/samples/streaming-auth-reconnect so onboarding shows best practice. current samples only show single-shot auth.

jamie: opened draft PR with sample + minimal SDK change to accept optional auth provider: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/pull/999 (ci runs green locally).

deploy-bot: CI: run/sdk-go-integration #482 passed — streaming-auth-reconnect sample smoke test ok (:thumbsup:)

olivia: quick UX note — mention this in the quickstart: "long-lived streams may require auth-provider pattern for rotating credentials". otherwise new users hit this and think streams are broken.

linus: agree. i'll do a small follow-up to add an example to the GenerateStream docstring and the quickstart snippet.

jamie: thanks team. landing the sample & doc follow-ups should remove this onboarding cliff. will post link to the final PR when merged. :party_popper:
